physicalNotes: Radius 0.09572681 Jupiter radii from Capistrant et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167...54C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167...54C/abstract): 6,843.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00394 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
